author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Super Mario Bros. Wonder — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park game is available now on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-mario-bros-wonder-nintendo-switch-2-edition-plus-meetup-in-bellabel-park-switch-2/ 

Come one, come all! New things are sprouting in the Flower Kingdom, including a new power-up, Rosalina and Luma, Assist Mode, Double Badges, and the Koopalings! 

And over in the brand-new Bellabel Park, there’s Camp Central with the Toad Brigade Training Camp, and Attraction Central with loads of multiplayer* attractions! So what are you waiting for?! 

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Super Mario Bros. Wonder on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by purchasing the upgrade pack. Three amiibo figures from Super Mario Bros. Wonder are also available now.
